<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-VARIANT: normal; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-STYLE: normal; TEXT-ALIGN: right"><u>Exhibit 99.1</u></div>

<div>&#160;</div>

<div>
<div id="DSPFPageHeader"></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; FONT: bold 12pt/1.25 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">Kamada Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter and First Nine Months of 2017</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Total Revenues for Third Quarter were $22.9 million, an 18% Increase</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Total revenues for first 9 months of 2017 were $67.1 million, a 26% Increase</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">On Track to Achieve $100 Million in Total Revenues in 2017</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Guiding to $116 to $120 Million in Total Revenues in 2018</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: center; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Conference Call Today at 8:30 AM ET</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">REHOVOT</font><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">, Israel &#8211; November 13, 2017 --</font> Kamada Ltd. (Nasdaq: KMDA) (KMDA.TA), a plasma-derived protein therapeutics company focused on orphan indications, today announced financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2017.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">&#8220;We had a very solid third quarter on all fronts,&#8221; said Amir London, Kamada&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer.&#160; &#8220;Total quarterly revenues of $23 million represented a year-over-year increase of 18%, and contributed to revenues for the first nine months of 2017 of $67 million, which was an increase of 26% over the first nine months of 2016.&#160; <font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">Our revenue growth continues to be driven by the higher Glassia&#174; sales in the US</font>.&#160; <font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">From a profitability standpoint, we generated positive operating and net income over the first nine months of the year.</font>&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">Following our strong performance through the first nine months of 2017, we remain confident in our ability to attain </font><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">our previously stated guidance of reaching $100 million in total revenue in 2017.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">&#8220;We were also pleased to have received the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval in the third quarter for our Anti-Rabies IgG,</font> KEDRAB&#8482;, and look forward to launching this product in the U.S. in collaboration with Kedrion, our strategic partner, early in 2018.<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">&#160; With the continued growth of sales of Glassia in the U.S. and our planned launch of KedRAB, we are expecting</font> total revenues in 2018 to be in the range of $116 to $120 million, or 16%-20% revenue growth for 2018 compared to 2017&#8217;s anticipated revenues.<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif"> Moreover, </font>following our <font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">$15.6 million equity offering, which closed in the third quarter, we are in an extremely strong financial position as we head into 2018,</font>&#8221; continued Mr. London.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">&#8220;Looking ahead, we have multiple expected upcoming clinical milestones, including finalization of our discussions with the FDA on our proprietary inhaled Alpha-1 Antitrypsin (AAT) for the treatment of AAT Deficiency and upon approval, the initiation of a U.S. Phase 3 pivotal clinical trial, expected in the second half of 2018.&#160; We are also looking forward <font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">to making progress in the Company&#8217;s clinical program for </font><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">our </font><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">AAT-IV for the treatment of acute Graft-Versus-Host Disease (GvHD), and determining the appropriate next steps forward in our clinical program for the treatment of newly diagnosed Type-1 Diabetes patients based on the recently announced Phase 2 results. </font>Finally, we also expect <font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">the availability of the interim report from our ongoing Phase 2 trial with IV AAT for lung transplantation</font> before year-end 2017,&#8221; added Mr. London.</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Third Quarter 2017 Financial Results Compared to Third Quarter 2016 Financial Results</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Total revenues for the third quarter of 2017 were $22.9 million, an 18% increase from the $19.4 million reported in the third quarter of 2016.&#160; Revenues from the Proprietary Products segment were $17.1 million, a 13% increase from the $15.0 million reported in the third quarter of 2016.&#160; Revenues from the Distributed Products segment were $5.9 million, a 35% increase from the $4.3 million reported in the third quarter of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Gross profit for the third quarter of 2017 was $6.4 million, a 3% increase from the $6.3 million reported in the third quarter of 2016.&#160; Gross margin decreased to 28% from 32% in the third quarter of 2016, primarily as a result of increase in scrap rates in production compared to the same quarter of last year.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">R&amp;D expenses for the third quarter of 2017 were $3.4 million, a decrease of 23% as compared to $4.4 million in the third quarter of 2016.&#160; Selling, general, and administrative expenses were $3.3 million, up 16% from $2.8 million in the same period in 2016.&#160; Operating loss was $0.3 million, significantly reduced from an operating loss of $1.0 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; Net loss for the third quarter of 2017 was $0.2 million, or $0.01 per diluted share, compared to a net loss of $1.0 million, or $0.03 per diluted share in the third quarter of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2017 was $0.8 million, compared with Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2016 of $0.2 million. Adjusted net loss for the third quarter of 2017 was less than $0.1 million, compared with an adjusted net loss of $0.7 million in the third quarter of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: -18pt">Nine Months Ended September 30, 2017 vs. September 30, 2016</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Total revenues were $67.1 million, a 26% increase from $53.2 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; Revenues from the Proprietary Products segment were $50.6 million, a 32% increase from $38.3 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; Revenues from the Distributed Products segment were $16.5 million, a 11% increase from the $15.0 million reported in the nine-month period of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Gross profit was $20.5 million, a 23% increase from the $16.7 million reported in the same period of 2016.&#160; Gross margin was 30%, somewhat consistent with the 31% in the same period of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">R&amp;D expenses were $10.1 million, a decrease of 16% as compared to $12.0 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; Selling, general and administrative expenses were $9.4 million, an increase of 14% compared to $8.2 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; The Company reported operating income of $1.0 million, compared with an operating loss of $3.6 million in the same period of 2016.&#160; Net income was $0.6 million, or $0.02 per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $4.9 million, or $0.14 per diluted share, in the same period of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">Adjusted EBITDA was $4.3 million, compared with Adjusted EBITDA of $0.1 million for </font>the same period of 2016<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif">.</font>&#160; Adjusted net income was $1.3 million compared to an adjusted net loss of $3.9 million in the same period of 2016.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-STYLE: italic; TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: -18pt">About Kamada</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">Kamada Ltd. is focused on plasma-derived protein therapeutics for orphan indications, and has a commercial product portfolio and a robust late-stage product pipeline. The Company uses its proprietary platform technology and know-how for the extraction and purification of proteins from human plasma to produce Alpha-1 Antitrypsin (AAT) in a highly-purified, liquid form, as well as other plasma-derived Immune globulins.&#160; AAT is a protein derived from human plasma with known and newly-discovered therapeutic roles given its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, tissue-protective and antimicrobial properties. The Company&#8217;s flagship product is GLASSIA&#174;, the first liquid, ready-to-use, intravenous plasma-derived AAT product approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Kamada markets GLASSIA&#174; in the U.S. through a strategic partnership with Baxalta (now part of Shire plc) and in other counties through local distributors.&#160; In addition to GLASSIA&#174;, Kamada has a product line of seven other pharmaceutical products administered by injection or infusion, that are marketed through distributors in more than 15 countries, including Israel, Russia, Brazil, India and other countries in Latin America and Asia. Kamada has five late-stage plasma-derived protein products in development, including an inhaled formulation of AAT for the treatment of AAT deficiency. In addition, Kamada's intravenous AAT is in development for other indications, such as type-1 diabetes, GvHD and prevention of lung transplant rejection. Kamada's rabies immune globulin (Human) product received FDA approval for Post-Exposure Prophylaxis against rabies infection in August 2017. Kamada also leverages its expertise and presence in the plasma-derived protein therapeutics market by distributing more than 10 complementary products in Israel that are manufactured by third parties.</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25"><br style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25">
